text:
Olivia (Finance): FYI: billing policy updates launching 2026-05-01. Main changes: 72h overage grace for metered accounts, small free-tier rate limit increases, and new promo credit expiry window for credits issued after launch. Brief rollout plan below.

Diego (Eng): Quick: is grace applied per-account or per-key?

Olivia (Finance): Per-account for invoicing; Console still shows per-key counters for debugging.

Rita (PM): Numbers for free-tier rps?

Olivia (Finance): Free-tier text endpoints 2 -> 4 rps, embeddings 1 -> 2 rps. Paid/Dedicated unchanged.

Sam (Support): How will this appear on invoices?

finance-bot: New invoice lines: 
- Usage: 1,250,000 tokens
- Overage charged (post-grace): 10,000 tokens @ $0.0009 = $9.00
- Grace window protection: -10,000 tokens (no charge during grace)

Nina (Legal): Note: grace window is a billing convenience; updated TOS draft linked in the doc.

Diego (Eng): API/webhook changes?

Olivia (Finance): We'll add a "grace_window_expires_at" field to usage webhooks and a header indicating grace status. Eng will get the contract today.

Rita (PM): Promo credit expiry?

Olivia (Finance): New promo credits issued after 2026-05-01 expire after 180 days (previously 365). Existing credits keep their current expiry. Expiry visible in Console and emails.

Sam (Support): Any self-serve extension?

Olivia (Finance): Small auto-approved 30-day extensions for qualifying startups via support form; larger extensions need CS review.

Rita (PM): Rollout timeline?

Olivia (Finance): Internal docs and API header update next week, Console UI update in two weeks, customer emails scheduled 7 days prior. Briefing Friday 10:00 PT, recording available. Doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/2026-policy-change

Sam (Support): I'll update KB and canned replies. Will escalate tickets here. :thumbsup:
